thread:
sam (infra): FYI: scheduling a rolling NIC soft-reboot + short GPU cooldown in az24 tomorrow 01:30-04:30 UTC. Goal: apply NIC microcode fix that reduces packet reordering. We'll do small cohorts to protect latency-sensitive pools.
Priya: thanks. which pools are in scope and what's cohort sizing?
sam (infra): pools: az24-main-gpu, az24-ml-batch, az24-lowlat. Cohorts: main-gpu=10 nodes, ml-batch=20, lowlat=6 (extra safe). Drain window per cohort: 8m + 4m KV reseed + 15m cooldown.
lee.sre: can we run a dry-run of the drain on staging tonight to validate eviction thresholds? I want to ensure eviction doesn't move long-running work unintentionally.
sam (infra): good call. staging dry-run scheduled 22:00 UTC today. We'll reduce kube evict grace to 45s only during cohorts to speed transition.
ops-bot: runbook created: https://runbooks.internal/ops/az24-nic-microcode. Checklist will post 01:10 UTC.
Notify Bot: customer notice draft queued to #customer-impact: "Planned maintenance in az24 may cause brief latency increases for batch/analytics workloads between 01:40-04:20 UTC. Low-latency customers should be minimally impacted."
Priya: cost note: routing ml-batch to az25-burst will add ~0.9k USD in GPU-hours and ~200GB egress; estimate total ~1.1k. Recommend partial shift to minimize spend.
sam (infra): plan: do partial shift for ml-batch (only non-critical queues), keep critical batch in place with graceful backlog drain. We'll also enable prefix KV cache for lowlat to shorten warmup.
lee.sre: monitoring plan: watch p99_api < 200ms, nic_tx_err_rate < 0.4%, gpu_temp < 80C. Alert if any breach during canary.
sam (infra): canary schedule: cohort 0 (2 nodes in main-gpu) at 01:40. If canary p99 OK and no nic errors, proceed every 20m.
ops-bot: preflight checks: node health ok, backlog < 800 reqs, KV seed jobs queued. Status: PENDING.
Priya: add cost center tag 'maint-az24-9150001234' to any migrated workloads. Also telemetry tag for post-analysis.
lee.sre: rollback criteria: any p99 > 250ms sustained for 3m or nic_err_rate > 1% -> abort and rollback routing.
sam (infra): commands for cohorts:
```
# start cohort drain
fleetctl evict --pool az24-main-gpu --nodes cohort-1 --grace 480
# trigger NIC soft-reboot
ssh node-123 "sudo nicctl soft-reboot"
# wait 15m cooldown and metrics stable
fleetctl resume --pool az24-main-gpu --nodes cohort-1
```
Priya: please limit cohort concurrency to 1 across pools to avoid compounding capacity pressure.
sam (infra): agreed, sequenced loop across pools. I'll open cross-region route override for non-critical ml-batch traffic: analytics->az25-burst 01:45-04:15 UTC.
Notify Bot: reminder set: 01:05 runbook check, 01:35 final go/no-go.
lee.sre: staging dry-run looked clean except for a transient NIC MIB spike, resolved after netdriver bounce. We'll keep a netdriver fallback on standby.
Priya: customer comm final: "Maintenance in az24, brief p99 fluctuations possible for analytics/batch 01:45-04:15 UTC. No impact expected for payments. Support will monitor." I'll post at 01:35 if GO.
(01:35) sam (infra): PRE-FLIGHT: green. starting runbook at 01:40.
(01:42) lee.sre: canary started. running p99 tests.
(01:50) lee.sre: canary PASS. p99 170ms, nic_err 0.05%. proceeding.
(02:30) sam (infra): update: cohorts 1-3 completed. one node in cohort 2 had elevated nic_rx_drops, we rotated that NIC, re-seeded KV, no user-visible errors.
(03:40) sam (infra): mid-window note: small latency bump for a handful of batch queues after redirect; mitigated by throttling ramp.
(04:10) sam (infra): final cohorts finishing. restoring default routing at 04:12 UTC.
(04:25) Priya: cost recap: final uplift ~950 USD, 180GB extra egress. Tags applied.
(04:30) sam (infra): closing ops thread. postmortem link: https://pm.internal/maint/az24-9150001234. Fill timeline and cost sections.
(04:32) Notify Bot: maintenance complete. :white_check_mark:"
